label: From DEF integers to microns
subgoals: Read n from the UNITS DISTANCE MICRONS statement
Divide the DEF integer by n to get microns
Keep integers inside the database and convert only at the edges

label: Die area from DIEAREA
subgoals: Subtract the corner coordinates to get width and height in dbu
Convert width and height to microns separately
Multiply the micron lengths for the area

label: LEF microns into DEF rows
subgoals: Multiply the LEF site width by n to get the step in dbu
Multiply the step by the site count and add the row origin
Confirm every converted value is an integer at the chosen resolution
